# SDK Field And Type Reference

Contract major: 1. Records: 155.
Source: provider-contract/schema.mjs (layout/defaults) and documentation.mjs (semantics).

## Reading Declarations

Kotlin Long maps to an exact integer JavaScript number, bounded by 9007199254740991.
Int uses the signed 32-bit range, with narrower host checks where documented.
Most counters/times are nonnegative; birthdayEpochMs permits pre-1970 values.
bytes maps to Kotlin ByteArray and TypeScript Binary (Int8Array or Uint8Array).
Do not use base64 strings or host paths for binary fields.

The default column describes Kotlin construction and missing-field decoding rules.
TypeScript nullable properties may be absent or null; non-null array properties may
be absent and decode as an empty list. This does not waive semantic requirements
such as a nonempty reorder list or one outcome per batch input.
Scalar defaults are Kotlin constructor defaults: required TypeScript properties
remain required, and a provider receives the host's complete typed request.
Null means unknown on result metadata and unchanged on patch fields where stated;
do not globally replace it with zero, false, empty text or an empty list.

IDs are normally opaque strings. Existing CommentItem/CommentReply and floor
operations retain numeric v1 IDs; do not change record layouts to hide that limitation.
The complete encoded request/result is bounded to 4 MiB, lists to 500 items.
Extended operations additionally bound nesting to 12, cursors to 4096 characters,
ordinary strings to 16384 and description/signature text to 65536 characters;
operation-specific rules can be stricter. These are host checks, not a promise that
every upstream service accepts the maximum. See ProviderHost and ExtendedOperationValidation.
